summary: Renamed the reasoning-strategy catalog to pmcro-omode per Shawn's live direction, relocated the per-Chief omode/*.yaml trigger tables into select-reasoning-strategy's own skill assets to resolve the naming collision he correctly identified, and completed the pending reasoning-strategy declarative-spec work from the prior sealed trail under the new name - all 35 strategies now have a spec, round-trip verified against the real files, not just the original 2. A repo-wide search before and after the edit (not a guessed file list) confirms every live reference was updated and nothing outside the intentionally-preserved historical design docs still names the old package.
earned_constraints: before a rename touching many files, search the whole repo for both the old term and any name it might collide with (here: 'omode' already meant something narrower) - the collision Shawn caught by just asking a question would have been missed by a naive find-replace that only looked for the term being renamed

when a rename intersects with in-progress, not-yet-committed work (here: 33 freshly-generated specs under the old path), fold both into one trail rather than trying to sequence them - the specs only existed correctly once, under the new name, verified together
